# Most Frequent Number Following Key In an Array.

@example Song 7 is followed by 3, then 5, then 3 again, so 3 is written down twice and 5 once.
[7,3,7,5,7,3,9]
7
=> 3

@example In the stretch 5, 5, 5 the second and third 5 each come right after a 5, so 5 is written down twice; 8 and 2 only once each.
[5,5,5,8,5,2]
5
=> 5

@example The 2 at the end has nothing after it; the other two 2s are both followed by 8. Songs played just before a 2 do not count.
[9,2,8,9,2,8,4,2]
2
=> 8

# The shortest log.
[1,2]
1
=> 2

# The shortest log, key twice.
[5,5]
5
=> 5

# key first and last: only the first one has a song after it.
[3,6,3]
3
=> 6

# The song most often just before key (4) is not the answer.
[4,8,6,4,8,6,1,8,4]
8
=> 6

# The most common song overall (5) is not the answer.
[5,5,5,5,1,2,1,3,1,2]
1
=> 2

# A stretch of key is beaten by another song written down three times.
[2,2,4,2,4,2,4]
2
=> 4

# The largest values; the last 1000 has nothing after it.
[1000,1,1000,1,1000]
1000
=> 1

# key once, with the same song repeated after it.
[3,7,7,7,7]
3
=> 7

# key once, just before the last entry; 8 fills most of the log.
[8,8,8,2,1]
2
=> 1
